# Lyricar

> Open source iOS 26 app (Apache-2.0) that shows line-synced lyrics for whatever is playing on your Spotify, on the iPhone, the Lock Screen, the Dynamic Island, widgets and CarPlay. Not on the App Store; you build it from source with Xcode 26 and your own Spotify developer app. Lyrics come from LRCLIB at runtime. Not affiliated with Spotify.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://lyricar.adatepe.dev/): the now playing screen, every surface, how sync works, the eight styles, a demo video, build steps and limits

- [Changelog](https://github.com/noluyorAbi/lyricar/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/noluyorAbi/lyricar/security/policy)

## Facts

- Spotify is polled once a second while the phone or CarPlay shows lyrics, every 3 seconds otherwise; a 429 pauses polling for Retry-After.
- A local 10 Hz clock moves the line between polls; the sync tests hold it within 60 ms.
- Spotify Development Mode limits a self-built app to 5 users, and the owner needs Spotify Premium.
- Only two services are contacted: the Spotify Web API and LRCLIB. No backend, no analytics.
